title: dvload run plan (.dvplan.json)
description: Orchestrates several .dvmap.json runs with staging and dependency ordering. Mirrors parseRunPlan + validateRunPlan in packages/core/src/run-plan.ts and validatePlanMappings in packages/cli/src/commands/run-all.ts, which remain the enforcement point. Two forms are accepted: the current steps[] form and the legacy runs[] manifest, which is upgraded in memory. `node tests/schema-parity.mjs` checks that this file and the parsers agree.
x-not-enforceable: Step ids must be unique. uniqueItems compares whole items, not one property.
dependsOn and alternateKeyLinks.fromStep must name existing steps, and not the step itself. Draft-07 cannot reference sibling array contents.
The dependency graph must be acyclic. Not expressible at all; validateRunPlan does a DFS.
alternateKeyLinks consistency with the referenced .dvmap.json files. Requires reading other files; validatePlanMappings does this before execution.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Rewritten by serializeRunPlan on every save.

stopOnError.description: Stop after any stage that had a failure. Steps already running in that stage still complete; later stages are not attempted.

steps.description: Step ids must be unique. Steps with no unsatisfied dependency and the same stage run in parallel.

id.description: Unique step id, referenced by dependsOn and alternateKeyLinks.fromStep.

mapping.description: Path to a .dvmap.json, resolved relative to the plan file. Parsed and validated before any step executes.

workbook.description: Path to the .xlsx/.csv/.tsv source, resolved relative to the plan file.

refresh.description: Refresh Power Query in this workbook before reading. Windows-only; requires Excel desktop.

stage.description: Barrier number. If ANY step declares a stage, every step implicitly depends on all steps with a lower stage, so stages act as ordered barriers rather than labels.

dependsOn.description: Explicit upstream step ids. Must name existing steps, must not name this step, and must not form a cycle.

alternateKeyLinks.description: Cross-step lookup wiring. Each link also implies a dependency on fromStep, so ordering need not be restated in dependsOn.

runPlanStepOverrides.description: Per-step overrides. These take precedence over the equivalent run-all command-line flags.

maxErrors.description: Overrides mapping.maxErrors for this step. 0 = unlimited.

notifyUrl.description: Webhook for this step's summary. https, or http://localhost for testing.

dryRun.description: Coerce and plan without writing to Dataverse.

user.description: Force delegated auth even when app-only credentials exist.

failedRows.description: false suppresses the failed-rows .xlsx for this step (the equivalent of --no-failed-rows).

alternateKeyLink.description: Asserts that a lookup in this step resolves against a key the upstream step writes. Enforced by validatePlanMappings before execution: the upstream mapping must include keyAttribute in its upsertKey, and this step's lookupTarget column must be a lookup with lookupResolution=alternateKey and the same keyAttribute.

fromStep.description: Upstream step id that writes the parent records first.

lookupTarget.description: Column target (navigation property) in this step's mapping.

keyAttribute.description: Alternate-key attribute shared by the upstream upsertKey and this lookup.

legacyManifest.title: Legacy run-all manifest
legacyManifest.description: Pre-run-plan format. Upgraded in memory to one step per entry with id "run-<n>" and stage <n>, i.e. strictly sequential. Note stopOnError defaults to true here as well (only an explicit false disables it).
